about.paragraph: I am a Lecturer in the Department of CSE at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur. I completed my B.Sc. in CSE with a CGPA of **3.96 out of 4.00** and am currently pursuing my M.Sc. in CSE at RUET with a coursework CGPA of **3.75 out of 4.00**. My research spans computer vision, lightweight neural architectures, explainable AI, deep learning, multimodal learning, and vision-language models, with a focus on video analytics and applied AI for healthcare, agriculture, and educational assessment.

bullets: Taught Courses: Digital Logic Design, Computer Graphics, and sessional (laboratory) courses on Digital Image Processing, Operating Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Data Structures and Algorithms I, Numerical Methods, Database Management Systems, and Introduction to Computer Systems, to 400+ students.
Co-supervised 6 undergraduate thesis groups, guiding them through research, experimentation, and publication.
Organized workshops and academic events on programming and robotics for students.

thesis.title: Fish Behaviour as an Early Warning of Water Quality Problems Using Video-Based Fish Tracking and Temporal Deep Learning
thesis.description: M.Sc. thesis, RUET. Supervisor: Dr. Julia Rahman. The study tracks fish movement in video and models temporal behavior to detect early signs of water-quality problems in aquaculture.

thesis.title: Bangla Sign Language Recognition: Dataset Innovation and Methodologies
thesis.description: B.Sc. thesis, BAUST. Supervisor: Prof. Dr. S. M. Jahangir Alam. Built a new Bangla Sign Language dataset and compared deep learning methods, including ensemble techniques.
